frames.label: MakerBeam, MicroRax, and 80/20 modular rails are produced by aluminum extrusion rather than milling
frames.main_point: MakerBeam, MicroRax, and 80/20 modular rails are produced by aluminum extrusion rather than milling. Recreating their precise cross-sectional features by CNC milling (e.g., in wood) does not align with the original manufacturing method.
frames.source_quote: The main problem you will have with this idea is that the MakerBeam / MicroRax / 80/20 rails are extruded aluminum, not milled.
